Wii U sound/se/snd_se_enemy_%s.nus3bank (rodata +0x158D64) with the capitalised name table 0x1041A534; tools/s3ds_enemy.py already copies the banks (step 2a adds capitalised copies)

sound_plan.ids: A sound id is (bank << 16) | tone. The 3DS banks: kuribo 0x28D, patapata 0x28E, dekakuribo 0x291, heiho 0x69B, plasmawisp 0x6A2, waddledoo 0x6A8, furiijio 0x6A9, churine 0x6B0, darios 0x6B2, stalfos 0x6BF, whitebear 0x6CC, propellerheiho 0x6D2, togezo 0x6D9, tikibuzz 0x89C, ghos 0x8A6 (common: 0x4A6, id 15). The Wii U uses its own bank numbers (Mczakoplasmawisp 0xBE2, Mczakodarios 0xBE3, Mczakostalfos 0xBE4, others 0x837 / 0x8EB / 0x8EC / 0x8EF / 0x925 / 0x2C2 in 0x026B0000-0x026E8000). The bank number is not in the nus3bank (BINF holds the name and a file id, e.g. kuribo 0x138A) nor in config.nus3conf by name; sound/config/soundlabeltable.bin ("STB", header 0xCB4 / 0xCB40 / 0x7D0 / 0x19F) holds u16 bank numbers (0x0BE3 at +0x925E).
steps: Decode soundlabeltable.bin (and the loader that reads snd_se_enemy_%s) to learn how a bank number maps to a file; find free numbers (or check whether the 3DS numbers 0x28D... are free on the Wii U) and register one bank per Smash Run kind.

A cave helper snd(id) = bl 0x026A96EC with r4 = (WIIU_BANK[kind] << 16) | tone, r5 = 0; store the handle where the 3DS does (Waddle Doo +0x1A4 -> a V word, Furiijio +0x260 -> FU_E slot, Ghos +0x200, Darios +0x19C) and stop it with 0x026A970C where the 3DS stop_se is (exits / damage / remove).
Rewrite the converted ACMD Sound_Effect arguments with the same map (tools/s3ds_enemy.py acmd_be), so the ACMD sounds land in the new banks.
Twins: check in game whether 0xBE2 / 0xBE3 / 0xBE4 resolve to K's bank; if not, the twin calls need the same remap (or the twin bank names registered for K).
Propeller Heiho's loop is counted per kind (one loop for all of them): a kind-wide counter word in the cave data.
